subject: CPPO Go-Live: entitlement mapping & DocuSign readiness
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudresellco.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Partner Success <aws-ppo@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness – entitlement mapping + DocuSign

Hi Tessa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Quick summary from our side and a couple of blockers we hit while testing the CPPO activation flow: 

1) Entitlement mapping mismatch – several of our SKU IDs (legacy catalog) are not matching the CPPO entitlement mapping you sent. This prevents the partner subscriber from receiving the correct credits in their invoice.
2) DocuSign template – we tried to load Redwood's partner DocuSign template via the DocuSign link you shared; your template references a clause id that our signer experience flags as missing ("PAYER_ENTITY_ID").  Vendor legal asked for an editable PDF to patch locally.
3) SLA doc question – the activation flow references a 99.9% SLA but our procurement team expects 99.95 for our EU customers. We need a one-line confirmation for the resale listing.

Attachments: entitlement-mapping-current.xlsx (export), reseller-test-screenshots.zip (summary).

Can we get a short triage call today (30 min) so we can share the failure traces? If not, tomorrow morning CET works for our team.

Best,
Emma
Director, Channel Ops
CloudResellCo

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness – entitlement mapping + DocuSign

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear summary. Really appreciate the screenshots, they helped pinpoint the mapping gap. Quick plan and owners: 

- Ben (cc) will take the entitlement mapping lead — he will reconcile legacy SKU IDs with the CPPO catalog.
- Aditya (cc) will validate the DocuSign template and push an editable PDF if we need to update placeholder clauses.
- Laura (cc) will confirm the SLA language and whether 99.95 can be reflected in the reseller's listing for EU customers.

Proposed next steps (I can host a 30-min triage at 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT if that works):
- Ben to attach an updated mapping (.xlsx) and call out any SKUs that need manual entitlement bridging.
- Aditya to produce a patched DocuSign PDF and a short note on the signer flow gaps.
- Laura to confirm SLA delta; if SLA change ok, we will update the marketplace listing and the activation runbook.

I attached the CPPO activation runbook and the DocuSign link for reference (we'll share an editable PDF if needed).

Thanks — talk soon.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ppo-activation-sla.pdf (runbook extract)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudresellco.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness – entitlement mapping + DocuSign

Emma / team — I pulled the legacy export and compared it to the CPPO entitlement list. Key findings inline: 

> "several of our SKU IDs (legacy catalog) are not matching the CPPO entitlement mapping you sent."

- Confirmed: ~18 SKUs are using old prefixes (CR- vs CRX-). CPPO expects the CRX- prefix.
- Action: I've normalized the legacy IDs and created a v2 mapping that includes fallback aliases for the CPPO entitlement engine. See attached: entitlement-mapping-v2.xlsx
- Manual bridge required: 4 special SKUs (lines highlighted) have custom billing attributes in the reseller billing tenant; those will need a one-time entitlement patch post-activation.

Next steps for today: 
- Emma: please test the attached v2 mapping against your staging subscriber (one account is fine). If you still see missing entitlements, send me the specific subscriber ID and I will run a debug pass.
- Aditya: flag whether DocuSign template changes require new signature tabs or placeholder updates (I can hot-fix if needed).

Attached: entitlement-mapping-v2.xlsx (mapping + alias column)

Thanks — Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: CPPO readiness – entitlement mapping + DocuSign

Forwarding the thread for legal/finance sign-off. Short summary for context: CloudResellCo tested CPPO activation and hit a SKU-prefix mapping gap (Ben attached v2 mapping) and a DocuSign placeholder issue (DocuSign link below). Laura — can you confirm if we can accept the stated 99.95% SLA in the EU listing or if finance/legal need a tighter commitment? Aditya — can you validate the DocuSign template (reseller-docsign-template.pdf) and confirm whether we can provide the editable PDF to the partner or if we must lock clauses server-side?

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/envelopes/EG-9b2c3f1a
Attachment references: entitlement-mapping-v2.xlsx, reseller-docsign-template.pdf, ppo-activation-sla.pdf

Please reply with approvals or required edits by EOD CET tomorrow so we can keep the scheduled go-live slot.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
